description: Defines an abstract class ReadOnlyStream implementing a read-only stream wrapper interface for Drupal, handling stream operations with restrictions on write and modification methods.

classes.name: ReadOnlyStream
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for read-only stream wrappers in Drupal, implementing core stream operations with restrictions on write and modification functionalities.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the stream instance.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI of the stream instance.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Supports opening a stream with read-only modes, initializes handle and URI.

methods.name: getLocalPath
methods.description: Throws exception if not implemented; intended to return local filesystem path.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Handles flock operations, rejecting exclusive locks as read-only.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: No operation, returns FALSE as no data is stored.
